# GW8 Base Signal Agent API
> Monetized AI Trading Signal Endpoint on Base Mainnet.

## Service Details
- URL: https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/agent
- Method: POST
- Header Required: x-402-payment (Base Tx Hash)
- Price: 0.05 USDC
- Pay To Wallet: 0xB4527dccaC81eB73d4988A51a4cb1FBBF2C3CaBd
- Network: Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453)
- Token Contract: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

## Response Format
Returns live ETH/USD market analytics, 24h momentum change, algorithmic signal (BUY/HOLD/SELL), and confidence scores upon valid payment verification.
